notes: Board of Park Commissioners minutes, 1924. Curated: Kezar Stadium's contract and completion, the new Beach Chalet's budget and contract, the Tennis Stadium's dedication.

coverage.remaining: Not placed (no page): the Fleishhacker Pool bathhouse contracts (Gladding McBean tile, Empire Planing Mill, William F. Wilson plumbing, J. E. O'Mara heating), a Chain of Lakes comfort station (Reilly & Nemetz, Weeks and Day), the Lake Merced golf house and starter's house (George W. Kelham), the Legion of Honor's name and its Spreckels organ (dedicated January 11, 1925), a request to name the stadium for Frank McCoppin.

findings.description: The Board of Park Commissioners approved the plans for the new stadium on the old nursery site in Golden Gate Park and awarded its construction to the low bidder, Palmer and McBryde, for $164,300, over Eaton and Smith and Yukicevich and Bagge.

citation.label: Minutes of the Board of Park Commissioners, May 29, 1924

findings.description: The Board of Park Commissioners decided to spend $60,000 on a new Beach Chalet and had Commissioner Cummings and Superintendent John McLaren arrange its plans and specifications.

findings.description: The Board of Park Commissioners awarded the general construction of the new Beach Chalet to the low bidder, Barrett & Hilp, at $43,450; the other bids ran from $48,766 to $52,750.
